findings: VERDICT DERIVED: CS5 |- FS, mechanized sorry-free as cs5_fs (probes/fs-derivation-gate.lean), footprint [propext, Classical.choice].

The UNTRIED refutation direction is what decided the gate -- by proving refutation IMPOSSIBLE. A CS5 algebra is a Heyting algebra H plus a complete sublattice J with <> the reflector and [] the coreflector; bBox/bDia are precisely the unit/counit of the adjunction <> -| []. Every CS5 algebra validates FS, so no countermodel exists in the class, and the impossibility argument IS the derivation.

kBox is AUTOMATIC in the algebraic characterization ([](x->y) /\ []x lies in J and is <= y, hence <= []y). The only non-trivial CS5 constraint is kDia, which is EQUIVALENT to the Frobenius condition <>(u /\ x) = u /\ <>x for u in J.

REFUTES A LANDED CONCLUSION: probes/fischer-servi-probe.lean s NEGATIVE syntactic verdict -- self-described as not a search failure ... a structural mismatch -- is WRONG. Its argument (every route to A -> B needs the hypothesis H : <>A -> []B in context, so the resulting A -> B is never closed and necessitation is inapplicable) holds only for routes that keep H as a CONTEXT HYPOTHESIS. The derivation treats C := <>A -> []B as a FORMULA, proves the CLOSED theorem |- <>C -> (A -> B), necessitates THAT (legal, empty context), and re-attaches the hypothesis via bBox s C -> []<>C. bBox is exactly the internalise-a-hypothesis-under-a-box move the obstruction argument did not price in. The landed fs_context_relative_half is CIRCUMVENTED, not contradicted: it blocks the context-relative route; this is not that route.

AXIOM ECONOMY: the derivation uses implyK, implyS, andI, andE1, andE2, k, kdia, tDia, fourDia, bBox, bDia. tBox, fourBox, efq, orI1/orI2/orE are UNUSED -- FS already holds in CK + tDia + fourDia + B, strictly weaker than CS5. (fourDia is needed only to promote bBox s <>A -> []<><>A to <>A -> []<>A.)

COLLATERAL CORRECTION: FS1 (<>(A->B) -> ([]A -> <>B)) is derivable in PLAIN CK and is not the hard Fischer-Servi axiom; the hard one is FS2 = (<>A -> []B) -> [](A -> B) (Simpson s k4), which is what CSLib s FS denotes. Relevant to reading IK = CK + k3 + k4 + k5 against CK + FS1 + FS2.
